title: The finite compact-support tower has a normalized DVR realization and uniform bounds
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, K₀ an arbitrary field with l invertible, X,Y finite-type quasi-compact K₀-schemes, f:X→Y a separated finite-type quasi-compact K₀-map, and c=(X→Z→Y) a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let K in the derived category of integral module sheaves on X be integral constructible in the sense of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], so it is derived complete and its reductions K_n modulo the positive exponents n+1 have constructible cohomology with a common bounded interval [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. Write V_n=Rp_*j_! K_n, the finite compact-support terms of [def-pur-operation-scalar-transport], and v_n for their specified transitions after restriction. For every indexing finite-field datum D with l≠D.p there exists a normalized DVR tower T [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], with isomorphisms a_n:T.M_n≅V_n, such that its evaluation isomorphism followed by restricted a_n intertwines every adjacent transition with v_n. There is one interval [b₀,b₁], b₀≤b₁, on which all V_n have constructible cohomology and outside which their cohomology vanishes. No base structure over D is assumed. The assertion concerns only the finite tower: it has no integral limit M, no projection p, and no conclusion about their reduction comparisons. The displayed squares and quantifiers are recorded verbatim in Lean.

proof.text: Take flat-term K-flat representatives of K and use the finite-free resolution of each positive quotient of the integral DVR to identify its iterated derived reductions with its quotient levels. The coefficient comparison maps are normalized by their scalar units.

Extension by zero is exact and its reduction comparison is sectionwise tensor by the unit. For the proper image, apply the perfect projection formula to the two-term finite free quotient complex. Thus finite compact support commutes with the quotient reductions through the specified scalar-adjunction mates.

These mates preserve quotient composition and identities on representatives. Coherent tower assembly and substitution provide a normalized DVR tower and its level isomorphisms. Their restriction squares give the displayed adjacent transition equation, without making any inverse-limit comparison.

Finite compact-support constructibility gives constructible finite levels. Apply the relative proper cohomological bound to the common bounded interval of the input reductions; exact extension by zero does not enlarge it. The fixed finite-type map has a bound independent of the exponent, giving b₀,b₁. This is the bounded finite-level part of the proper-image limit argument and does not invoke integral operation reduction.

theorem compactSupport_normalizedReductionTower
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (K₀ : Type u) [Field K₀] (hl₀ : IsUnit (l : K₀))
    [X.Over (Spec (.of K₀))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of K₀))] [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X))
    (hK : sfIntegralConstructible l E X K)
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p) :
    ∃ (T : NormalizedDVRTower l E Y D hl)
      (a : ∀ n : ℕ, T.M n ≅
        (sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) c).obj
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K)),
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        (normalizedDVRTowerTransition l E Y D hl n.le_succ).app T.tower ≫
            (T.evaluationIso n ≪≫
              (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E Y n).mapIso (a n)).hom =
          (T.evaluationIso (n + 1) ≪≫
              (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E Y (n + 1)).mapIso (a (n + 1))).hom ≫
            sfCompactSupportTransition l E c K n) ∧
      ∃ b₀ b₁ : ℤ, b₀ ≤ b₁ ∧ ∀ n : ℕ,
        intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E (n + 1)
          (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)) Y
          ((sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate
            (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) c).obj
              ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K)) ∧
        proEtaleCohomologicalSupport
          ((sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate
            (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) c).obj
              ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K)) ⊆ Set.Icc b₀ b₁
